value.title: Project manager
value.line: Runs a workstream: writes packets, assigns coders and reviewers, keeps states true.

sections.name: purpose
sections.value: Runs one workstream. It writes one packet per step, assigns coders and reviewers, hands out numbers, asks for verdicts, and keeps requirement and step states true in the PRs that deliver them.

sections.name: lifecycle
sections.value: Kept for the life of its workstream, because it holds the workstream's history. Compacted when large, after writing memory.

sections.name: keeps
sections.value: The workstream's history: its document, its packets, and memory notes of what was decided and why.

value.text: Keeps the workstream's history in the workstream document and its memory, so a successor can take it over.
Writes a memory note before it is compacted or closed.
